ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of posterior abdominal structures, with labels 107 to 113 marking different structures with leader lines. The leader line of label 112 is located on the left side of the image, pointing to a bend formed superiorly by a large intestinal tube with a haustral appearance; this bend is located near the upper end of the ascending colon. Reasoning: A large intestinal tube with haustra suggests the colon. The colonic bend at the upper end of the ascending colon, on the right side and located below the liver, is anatomically named the hepatic flexure, also called the colic hepatic flexure. Therefore structure 112 is the colic hepatic flexure.
